mapper.select: SELECT a.*, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar, c.name AS category_name, c.slug AS category_slug FROM article a LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = a.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = a.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.deleted = 0

SELECT a.id, a.user_id, a.title, a.cover, a.summary, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.comment_count, a.publish_time, a.category_id, c.name AS category_name, c.slug AS category_slug FROM article a LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = a.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 ORDER BY a.view_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, title, cover FROM article WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND publish_time < (SELECT publish_time FROM article WHERE id = #{id}) ORDER BY publish_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, title, cover FROM article WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND publish_time > (SELECT publish_time FROM article WHERE id = #{id}) ORDER BY publish_time ASC LIMIT 1
